in_sanskrit.name: अश्वतथामा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who does not have a horse. In Hindu mythology, Ashvathama is the name of a great warrior in the Mahabharata epic. He was a disciple of Bhishma Pitamaha and fought on the side of the Kauravas. He is known for his bravery and his use of the powerful weapon, the Ashvatthama Asura weapon.

in_marathi.name: Ashvathama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashvathama हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashvathama is a name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ashva’ meaning horse and ‘tama’ meaning born.
